# Velvet Dinosaur

Velvet Dinosaur is a one-person web design business run by Ian Wickens from Minster Lovell, near Witney in Oxfordshire, UK. It designs, builds and looks after websites for small businesses, charities and community groups. Each website is built before the client pays; if they go ahead it is a managed monthly service with hosting, updates and support included.

## Crawling Guidance

Public marketing and case-study pages may be crawled for search and discovery. Administrative, preview, edit, and demo routes should not be crawled or indexed.
